status: Design sensitivity assumptions; no force-to-volume model or physical results
limits: Gas-law sensitivity only. The channel wall, contact area, bulk elastomer and TPU share mechanical loads.
Do not equate external finger force with pressure times channel area.
Internal sensor/fitting volume is unknown; the listed values are deliberately varied assumptions, not measured dimensions.
No leakage, tube-wall compliance, pneumatic flow resistance, transient gas heating, viscoelasticity or sensor error/noise is modeled.
A remote unloaded reference may be at a different temperature from the finger chamber.
A 20 N force rating or 0.2 N contact threshold cannot be inferred without a measured or validated deformation model.
